about: Wockhardt Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a pharmaceutical and biotech company, in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It manufactures and trades pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemical, and botanical products, as well as chemicals and chemical products.
